limitations: The model describes the active executable generation and exact unsigned-integer order; it is not a forecast of future supply, yield, price, or governance outcomes.

The whitepaper's locked-supply description conflicts with the active minter's use of prior-boundary unboosted time-decayed voting power; deployed behavior is recorded separately and takes precedence for this scope.
Splitter needles are governed state, not constants. Consumers must read them at the relevant block or transaction pre-state.
Catch-up processing is capped per call and delayed distributor checkpointing can change historical weekly attribution.
All thirteen referenced registry roles are accepted under registry provenance review and emission evidence review; registry acceptance creates no writer support.

formulas.rounding: Every division floors in the listed order; regrouping is not equivalent.
zeroCases: A zero pre-emission total supply produces zero emission.
formulas.scope: Active MEZOMinter executable at the evidence block.

integerOrder: Return 0 when emissions are disabled, emissionRaw is 0, preEmissionTotalSupplyRaw is 0, or period is 0.
formulas.rounding: The two supply divisions and final division by two floor sequentially.
zeroCases: Disabled emissions, zero emission, zero supply, zero period, or voting power at/above supply returns zero.
formulas.scope: Active MEZOMinter and veMEZO executable generations at the evidence block.
formulas.specificationConflict: The current whitepaper explains the ratio using locked veMEZO supply. The deployed minter instead reads unboosted, time-decayed voting power at period - 1; these quantities are not interchangeable.

zeroCases: A zero emission has zero rebase and zero rewards.
formulas.scope: The rebase and reward branches partition one minted epoch budget; they are not additive mints.

formulas.rounding: All floor dust is retained by the second recipient.
governedInputs: needle may move by one tick per splitter epoch through its bound epoch governor, within [1,100]
zeroCases: A zero balance transfers zero to both recipients; small balances can floor the first amount to zero.
formulas.scope: Both active chain and ecosystem splitter executable generations at the evidence block.

processing.catchUp: updatePeriod processes min(elapsed weekly epochs, 20) in chronological order, advances supply by each epoch emission before calculating the next epoch, then mints the aggregate once.
processing.transfers: The aggregate rebase portion is transferred to the rebase distributor and checkpointed; the aggregate reward remainder is transferred to the chain splitter.
processing.splitterOrder: A splitter first invokes its upstream update hook, then snapshots its full token balance and distributes it using the current needle.
processing.rebaseClaims: Weekly allocation floors votingPowerOfNFTAt(weekEnd) * tokensPerWeek / max(totalVotingPowerAt(weekEnd), 1). Expired non-permanent locks receive liquid tokens; other eligible locks receive depositFor. LOCKED escrow type is rejected.
processing.delayCaveat: The distributor checkpoint loop advances at most 20 weeks and each claim advances at most 50 weeks; long inactivity can make old weekly attribution incomplete.

accountingBoundaries: MEZO total supply increases by the epoch emission exactly once.
The rebase and rewards amounts are transfers of that minted budget, not additional supply changes.
The chain splitter separates ecosystem and validator destinations.
The ecosystem splitter separately routes to PoolsVoter and the third-party voter.
Pool gauge indexing, validator allocation, and third-party allocation are downstream accounting domains and do not redefine the minter budget.
analyticsBoundary: Future emission projections require future supply and epoch assumptions and are not canonical facts.
APR, APY, token price, user yield, and governance-outcome predictions are excluded.
